calibration.headline: Holding steady: finish the full week, including Wednesday.

adjustments.text: Thanksgiving: do the tempo ride in the morning
Split squat: keep 10 lb, cut reps if it hurts

days.name: Monday
days.title: The HIIT Engine
days.text: 30 min stationary bike, level 1. Warm up, then 4 rounds of 3 min max effort + 3 min easy spin.

days.name: Wednesday
days.title: Bike + Reformer Pilates
days.text: 20–30 min easy bike warm-up at home, immediately followed by Reformer Pilates.

days.name: Thursday
days.title: Swim or Tempo Burn
days.text: 35 min bike tempo burn (comfortably hard), level 1: 1 x 15 min at tempo.

days.name: Friday
days.title: Bike + Reformer Pilates
days.text: 20–30 min steady bike base spin at home, immediately followed by Reformer Pilates.

days.name: Saturday
days.title: Full Reset
days.text: No structured workouts. Let HRV rebound, allow muscle repair, and lower baseline heart tension.

days.name: Sunday
days.title: Full Reset
days.text: No structured workouts. Let HRV rebound, allow muscle repair, and lower baseline heart tension.
